m_dialogEntries.m_dialog: You retrieved the Tablet! Isn't it beautiful? Just think, these runes, these hallowed words, were inscribed by Grandmother Raven herself!
If only I could read this ancient language. Alas, that task was never meant for me anyhow. But there should be someone who can...
The Alphoi were handpicked by Raven to be the stewards of Her Edicts. So in theory, there should be an Alphoi who can decipher this Tablet.
If you ever make it off this forsaken rock and find yourself in Zanadu, look for an Alphoi Custodian in a special library called the Aethyrium.
No! Leave me be, vile Shadow Beast- Wait! Is that... A Raven's Edict Tablet! Give it to me now! How did you come by such an important relic?
Rescued it from an overly-maternal Monkey Spider on Aeriel, you say? Amazing! You must be quite the powerful traveling Wizard creature!
As an Aethyrium Custodian, it's my job to study and teach the Edicts of Raven. But for generations now, we've been relegated to cleanup duty.
You see, long ago, even before the reign of Queen Shaka, Raven's Edicts were stolen from the Aethyrium by an evil witch named Sycorax.
But as she was fleeing with the pilfered Tablets, she was waylaid by an Aethyr storm. Sycorax and the Edicts of Raven were never seen again!
At least, that's how the story was told to me. You know, some believe that theft was the harbinger of our current woes...
You're not one of the typical castaways we get here, are you? No, I recognize a fellow adventurer when I see one.
I left home years ago to find Raven's Edicts - the guiding principles handed down to the four races of Empyrea at the dawn of time.
The Tablets the Edicts were inscribed upon were lost long ago; scattered all over Empyrea. When I crashed here, I thought my quest was over.
But I found one in the Monkey Spider Cave! If I hadn't been so distracted by its majesty I'd have noticed the Mother Monkey Spider lurking behind me.
I escaped with my life, but not the Tablet. If you're up to it, shoo that mad Mother Monkey Spider away and retrieve the lost Edicts of Raven!
One of the lost Edicts of Raven Tablets is in the Monkey Spider's Nest. If you go after it, keep and eye out for the mad Mother Monkey Spider!
